direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; independent reserved zones for callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; scene at least 70% of main; condense side content inside its reserved zone; all targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary text; emerald #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions preserved: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels, one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries second logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps connection readiness, checking provider identity, separate from investigation as a distinct evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; pending proposal deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and approved plan coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory SVG to at least 70% of main; refit stations, jobs and options as SVG layers rather than flat stacked cards, adding material flow and state glow.
Raise rail labels to 16px and body copy to a consistent 16px/24; shrink the evidence zone height so the scene gains vertical dominance at 1366x768.
Add bidirectional highlighting between Certificate 120 / Receiving 80 tracks, Receiving, CELL-MILL-1 and CELL-MILL-2, with keyboard-focusable nodes and 2px emerald focus ring.
In the side zone, separate connection readiness with provider identity check from the investigation evidence task using distinct headings, statuses and controls; do not merge their primary actions.
Enlarge scene to at least 70% of main and animate feasible material flow only on real state change; keep sample route visually quieter than live state.
Raise small helper text to at least 12px micro-labels and body to 16px; make Run Sample investigation the sole emerald primary.
When an option is selected, open the typed consent form directly; keep Review recovery option disabled or clearly pre-selection until a path is chosen.
Make the three comparison rows mirror SVG highlighting on hover and keyboard focus, showing 83h/$0, 35h/$3,115 and 17.5h/$3,202.50 as tabular 26px metrics.
Grow the scene share and reduce empty lower side-zone space by condensing comparison cards inside their reserved zone.
Keep typed consent prominent, show exact phrase progress at 16px, and enable Accept only on exact match with aria-live polite confirmation.
Add a visible focus ring to the consent input and Selected path row; ensure Esc returns focus to the selected recovery option.
Refit scene stations to reflect the selected split path with a single 240ms emerald route trace, then static glow.
Replace card-grid task presentation inside the scene with job layer over the factory SVG, preserving untracked-until-approval dashed treatment for all 3 proposed tasks.
Condense the right board so task pager, proposed detail and approval status fit without crowding; keep Approve Britt's proposal as sole primary.
Correct inconsistent task bars: show progress only where state supplies it, otherwise use dependency text After t1 / After t2.
Strengthen the shock preview: CELL-MILL-2 silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain OFFLINE text in the SVG with no route through it, while CELL-MILL-1 keeps emerald recovery flow.
Make 24h to 0h a large tabular metric tied to the SVG node, and highlight it bidirectionally with the side-zone selector.
Raise selector and explanatory text to 16px body; keep Apply second shock as sole primary and warn of invalidation in the action-bar centre.
CELL-MILL-2 cross-hatching is effective; add a clear cross marker and ensure the label reads plain OFFLINE at glance size, with no feasible route crossing it.
Separate provider identity readiness from Reinvestigate recovery evidence action under distinct headings so the primary remains unambiguous.
Animate only the revised feasible flow through CELL-MILL-1 once on state change; respect reduced motion by leaving pattern and text as carriers.
Keep constrained Split path hatched with reason Split requires at least two online compatible cells directly linked to the OFFLINE CELL-MILL-2 node.
Make consent area fully visible within 1366x768 without crowding metrics; enlarge typed phrase and counter to 16px minimum.
On selection, trace the substitute route in emerald through available capacity only, then settle to static state glow.
Visually separate 3 blocked prior tasks from 3 proposed replacements with distinct reserved sub-zones, stating approved revised plan and replacement tasks await approval.
Remove progress-like bars from untracked proposed tasks or label them as dependency position, avoiding implied completion.
Enlarge scene task layer and link each proposed task focus to its side-zone pager item with bidirectional highlighting.
Keep Verify ledger, Seal packet and Retain checkpoint as three stage cards, but connect them with a cinematic chain line and state glow driven by the 21 events.
Condense proof side zone so passphrase guidance, verify status and checkpoint action fit cleanly at 1366x768; raise small text to at least 12px.
Show 70 parts, 35h accepted and 48h comparison as aligned tabular metrics linked to the verified chain.
Enlarge every machine glyph and OFFLINE label; current cubes are too small to judge state across Saw, CNC mills, CNC lathes, Heat treat, Inspection, Finishing and Assembly.
Add state-driven material flow and feasible recovery routes between departments, not only department boxes, while stopped machines keep silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain OFFLINE text.
Refit department zones to fill the viewport evenly, raise count text to 16px, and make each machine keyboard-focusable with bidirectional department highlighting.
Enlarge the embedded full-shop screenshot or crop to a legible hero detail; at current size machines and metrics are unreadable and weaken judge impact.
Lead with the specified presentation order in one scannable opening block: fault, investigation, typed consent, second shock and proof, each with a single outcome line.
Preserve the official logo placement at the opening story, tighten Powered by into a compact strip, and make Open the recovery room the sole primary link near the top.
